verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a backend platform like Convex, but the pack documents no product feature for issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent. The nearest items are adjacent: the MCP server's default block on production access, and developer building blocks such as shared-secret checks and code-defined authorization rules. These do not earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
